title: The Model as One Rater Among Several: Measuring Political Positions in Data-Sparse Regions with a Language-Model Panel
abstract: arXiv:2606.23042v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Most instruments for measuring political positions, such as manifesto coding, expert surveys and text-scaling models, were built and validated on Western party systems, and they break down worst where many consequential actors never publish a manifesto, never contest a competitive election, or commit one position to a charter and act on another in office. This paper proposes a method for such settings. I treat a large language model as a single fallible rater in a panel, the way an expert survey treats one expert, and describe the panel, its synthesis, an applicability rule that keeps a blank distinct from a zero, and a lens that separates what an actor declares from what it does. Three results follow. First, a built-in experiment isolates the rubric: with a definition-free round held fixed, written axis definitions move scores by a mean of 1.8 points on a 21-point scale and tighten agreement between raters (mean absolute gap 2

translated_title: 模型作为多名评分者之一：利用语言模型面板测量数据稀缺地区的政治立场
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.23042v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：现有的大多数政治立场测量工具，如宣言编码、专家调查和文本缩放模型，都是在西方政党体系上构建和验证的，而在许多重要行为者从不发布宣言、从不参加竞争性选举，或在国内文件中承诺一种立场、执政时却推行另一种立场的地方，这些工具失效得最为严重。本文为这类情形提出了一种方法。作者将大型语言模型视为评分面板中的一名“单个可能出错的评分者”，就像专家调查对待某一位专家那样，并描述了该面板的构成、其综合方式、一条区分“空白”与“零”的适用性规则，以及一个将行为者宣称立场与其实际行为区分开来的视角。研究得出三项结果。第一，一项内嵌实验单独检验了评分规则的作用：在保持无定义轮次固定的情况下，书面化的维度定义使21分量表上的得分平均移动1.8个点，并收紧了评分者之间的一致性（平均绝对差距2……[原文截断]）
tldr: 该论文提出将大语言模型视为专家面板中的一名“可出错评分者”，用以测量宣言、专家调查等传统工具难以覆盖的数据稀缺地区行为者的政治立场，并能区分其宣称立场与实际行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes treating a large language model as one fallible rater within an expert-style panel to measure political positions of actors in data-sparse, non-Western settings, where traditional instruments fail, while distinguishing declared positions from actual behavior.
